verdict.rationale: monday.com says users can build their own agents in the product by describing a workflow in natural language, defining the goal and setting rules ([monday-docs-13], [monday-docs-14]). Admins can scope each agent's board access and audit its actions ([monday-docs-10]). Code-first agent building is also offered via the apps framework and a unified Models API ([monday-docs-2], [monday-docs-8]). missing for 10: in-depth configuration documentation beyond marketing-level claims (e.g. available tools, rules syntax, memory or knowledge settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent builder works as described.
